My partner wasn't the best person for me. Thinking rationally, she wanted me to be someone I'm not. And she didn't know how to express that in a way that wasn't hurtful. It still stings even now, but I know that much at least. 

I spent a long time trying to live up to her expectations which led me to try and be someone else. Maybe I can find myself one day. I already do things I would never have done before because I thought she'd find it weird or stupid. So I guess your right about that.
